digest.component_or_area: test harness / wiki render hardening tests
propositions: The test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer test intermittently kills its xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to per-test timeout firing when the monolithic test exceeds 300s budget under CPU saturation.

The test's cost is unbounded and load-dependent: 884 renderable units each rendered twice (1768 serial pandoc spawns) measure 91.6s idle but 504.8s under 2x hw.ncpu CPU contention, exceeding the 300s guard by 1.7x.
pytest-timeout's thread method calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the worker process without traceback or assertion output, producing no-properly-terminated xdist failures.
The fix chunks the equivalence test via parametrization with fixed _EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40 batches to bound per-test cost structurally, ensuring per-case budget remains independent of corpus growth.

All 884 units are still compared against the oracle with real pandoc and stride 1; byte-identity protection is untouched; new test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit ensures no chunks are silently dropped.
The osprey sharing commit 48a3ba0b8a did not cover this file, and the 14-minute gap between node-down log and crash report is a pytest session end delay artifact, not kill latency.
